mapper.sql: id, store_code,store_name,goods_code, goods_name, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete, org_code, biz_org_code
mapper.select: select orc.id, orc.store_code,orc.store_name,orc.goods_code, orc.goods_name, orc.creator, orc.create_time, orc.updater, orc.update_time, orc.is_delete, orc.org_code, orc.biz_org_code from gc_other_replenishment_config orc INNER JOIN sc_store_info ssi ON orc.biz_org_code = ssi.biz_org_code AND orc.store_code = ssi.erp_store_code AND ssi.is_delete = 0 where orc.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and ssi.store_property = #{storeProperty}
